"YAMAP -Social Trekking GPS App" vulnerable to improper access control
Overview
Android application "YAMAP -Social Trekking GPS App" provided by YAMAP INC. contains the following vulnerability:
Improper Verification of Source of a Communication Channel (CWE-940) - CVE-2026-85125
Koki Sato of BroadBand Security, Inc. reported this vulnerability to IPA.
JPCERT/CC coordinated with the developer under Information Security Early Warning Partnership.

Affected Products
YAMAP INC.
Android application "YAMAP -Social Trekking GPS App" versions v17.1.0 and earlier
Impact
The in-app browser may cause information leakage from the app or redirect users to unintended websites.
Solution
[Update the Application]
Update the application to the latest version according to the information provided by the developer.
